import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u020/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e9b0175b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            ys = [y for y,x in cells]; xs = [x for y,x in cells]
            y0,y1,x0,x1 = min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            colors = {grid[y][x] for y,x in cells}
            if len(colors) == 3:
                return [row[x0:x1+1] for row in grid[y0:y1+1]]
    raise ValueError("no three-color object")
'''
